(a) Similar triangles have sides 4, 6, 7 and 10, x, y: find x and y. (b) DE ∥ BC, AD = 3, AB = 12, DE = 2.5: find BC. (c) A 1.5 m pole casts a 2 m shadow; at the same time a tree casts a 14 m shadow: how tall is the tree? (d) Are triangles with sides 3, 4, 5 and 7.5, 10, 12.5 similar?
questions.a: (a) x = 15, y = 17.5 (b) BC = 10 (c) 10.5 m (d) yes: every side × 2.5
questions.model: (a) Scale factor = 10 ÷ 4 = 2.5; x = 6 × 2.5 = 15; y = 7 × 2.5 = 17.5. (c) Shadow scale factor 14 ÷ 2 = 7; height 1.5 × 7 = 10.5 m.

questions.q: DE ∥ BC with AD = 5, DB = 3 and DE = 4. Find BC.
Explain why two triangles with the same three angles must be similar.
questions.a: Fixing the angles fixes the shape; only the size can change, so one is an enlargement of the other.
A) equal angles and sides in the same ratio

questions.q: Scale factor 3: a 4 cm side becomes
Big question: how can you tell whether shapes are similar and find a missing length?
questions.a: Check corresponding sides are in the same ratio; then multiply by the scale factor.
